semantic_mapping.interpretation: Exploratory cosine bands, not calibrated biological confidence. A/B include all above-threshold ortholog pairs; C/D retain the previous top-k low-similarity retrieval scope. C is [0.5,0.7); D is below 0.5, archive-only and excluded from default-use views.

tier_definitions.name: Monarch phenotype bridge
tier_definitions.connection_basis: ClinVar condition to HPO to Monarch UPheno or MHMI HPO-MP to MGI allele, constrained by 1:1 orthology

tier_definitions.name: Ortholog-first phenotype evidence
tier_definitions.connection_basis: 1:1 ortholog first, then ClinVar or significant GWAS phenotype evidence compared with MGI MP and allele-name evidence
tier_definitions.interpretation: Candidate correspondence with within-tier support B or C; B is an exact normalized label and C a lexical hypothesis. Manual human literature phenotypes and support A are disabled.

tier_definitions.name: Curated disease model
tier_definitions.connection_basis: Exact OMIM identifier shared by a supported ClinVar condition and an MGI-curated mouse disease model, constrained by 1:1 orthology
tier_definitions.interpretation: Disease-model-level candidate correspondence independent of the HPO-MP bridge
